## What's new in 1.12.2

**Gateway and update server on Linux**
- **Self-update works.** The gateway's **Install** (web page, LuCI, `gundil-gateway update --install`) and the update server's **Update this server** failed on Linux with "mkdir /tmp/gundil-update…: read-only file system": the services may write only to their own folder. The download now goes to the system's temp folder when it can (RAM on OpenWrt), else next to the program, and is removed afterwards.
- **Once by hand:** a gateway or update server on 1.12.1 or older still has the old updater, so install 1.12.2 one time with the deploy script (`./app-gundil-gateway-deploy.sh root@<gateway>`, `./server-gundil-update-server-deploy.sh user@<server>`). Later versions then install themselves.
